result.description:
Seven Corp on behalf of Reofast


Overview: 

Reofast supplies, fabricates and installs reinforcing steel for premium residential builders across Perth, taking projects from take-off and quotation through to fabrication, delivery and installation. The business is committed to delivering high-quality reinforcement solutions through accuracy, efficiency and exceptional customer service.

We are seeking an experienced Construction Estimator to join our team in Perth, WA. In this role, you will be responsible for analysing structural and architectural drawings, preparing quantity take-offs and cost estimates, and developing reinforcement schedules and bar lists to support the accurate supply, fabrication and delivery of reinforcement steel products. This is a full-time ongoing position working 38 hours per week.


Main tasks:

-	Analysing structural and architectural drawings to determine reinforcement steel requirements for construction projects.
-	Preparing detailed quantity take-offs and cost estimates for steel supply, fabrication and delivery.
-	Developing reinforcement schedules and bar lists to ensure quantities align with structural and engineering drawings.
-	Preparing pricing breakdowns for materials, fabrication and logistics to support quotations and tender submissions.
-	Coordinating with structural engineers, architects, builders, site teams and suppliers to confirm project requirements, quantities and pricing.
-	Reviewing project variations and updating estimates, quantities and costs accordingly.
-	Preparing marked-up drawings and maintaining accurate estimating information across internal software systems.
-	Managing workload, priorities and deadlines to ensure quotations and reinforcement schedules are completed on time.
-	Liaising with clients and builders to ensure estimating is based on the latest project documentation.
-	Monitoring stock levels and assisting with supplier orders as required.
-	Maintaining accurate estimating records and reports.
-	Performing any additional duties as required from time to time.


Required/Relevant Qualifications & Work Experience:

-	Relevant qualification in Construction, Building, Engineering or a related discipline.
-	Alternatively, at least five years of relevant construction estimating experience may substitute for the formal qualification.


Required/Relevant Skills & Knowledge:

-	Strong communication skills with clients, staff and site tradespersons.
-	High attention to detail and accuracy.
-	Ability to read and interpret structural and architectural drawings.
-	Sound understanding of construction site operations and project requirements.
-	Ability to prepare accurate reinforcement schedules within required timeframes.
-	Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage priorities, workloads and deadlines.
-	Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with clients and suppliers.
-	Solutions-focused with a proactive and can-do attitude.
-	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Notion and Slack.
-	Ability to maintain accurate estimating records and reports.


 Annual salary will be between $90,000.00 to $110,000.00 (plus superannuation) depending on level of experience.

Seven Corp on behalf of Adelaide Steel Frame Windows

Overview: 

Adelaide Steel Frame Windows is South Australia’s largest manufacturer of architectural steel doors and windows. Operating successfully for over 24 years, our continued growth has led to a recent expansion into a larger facility in Regency Park. We take immense pride in our craftsmanship, solid work ethic, and supportive team culture.

We are seeking a dedicated, full-time Metal Machinist / CNC Specialist to join our production team. In this role, your primary responsibility will be setting up, programming, and operating precision tools and machinery to shape high-tolerance steel components for our bespoke architectural doors and windows.

This position is ideal for a precision-focused tradesperson with comprehensive experience in both complex manual milling and turning operations alongside advanced CNC programming. Working alongside our workshop floor team, you will enhance productivity, ensure strict quality control, troubleshoot manufacturing challenges, and assist in mentoring apprentice team members.

Main Tasks:

-	Interpret complex technical drawings, blueprints, and engineering specifications to determine job requirements, tooling needs, and sequence of machining operations.
-	 Set up, program, and operate a variety of machine tools including CNC processing machines, lathes, milling machines, and precision grinders to shape steel components.
-	Calculate engineering parameters, feed rates, and cutting speeds; check fabricated components for conformity and extreme precision using micrometers, calipers, and gauges.
-	Embrace daily tradesperson challenges to diagnose, troubleshoot, and enhance overall machining and manufacturing processes.
-	Work closely alongside the workshop floor team to achieve optimal assembly timeframes, minimise material wastage, and maintain high-quality project outcomes.


Required/Relevant Qualifications & Work Experience:

-	Minimum AQF Certificate III in Engineering - Mechanical Trade (Machining)
-	A minimum of one year of full-time proven professional experience setting up, programming, and operating both CNC and manual metalworking machinery, or
-	At least 3 years of relevant experience as a Metal Machinist to substitute the formal qualification.
-	Forklift license 
-	White card
-	Current driver’s license.

Required/Relevant Skills & Knowledge:

-	Demonstrated ability to write, edit, and optimise CNC programs (G-code/M-code or conversational) at the machine control panel.
-	High proficiency in traditional manual turning, milling, drilling, and surface grinding techniques.
-	Advanced skill in using precision measuring instruments (micrometers, height gauges, dial indicators, calipers) to hold tight tolerances.
-	Sound understanding of metal properties (specifically structural and architectural steel grades), insert selection, speeds, feeds, and coolant applications.
-	Strong spatial awareness and ability to convert complex 2D/3D engineering drawings into finished physical components.
-	Strong diagnostic skills for troubleshooting machining chatter, tool wear, and alignment issues.
-	Pride in producing clean, accurate, and repeatable craftsmanship suited for premium architectural applications.

If you are a motivated, Metal Machinist looking to become a critical part of our leading steel frame manufacturing business, please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your machinery experience, CNC programming capabilities, and alignment with our team values via the application link.

Annual salary will be between $75,000.00 to $85,000.00 (plus superannuation) depending on level of experience.

Full Time Architectural Draftsperson

Summary
Smart Hill Construction Pty Ltd, trading as Reso Scaffold, is a growing construction company specialising in residential, commercial and industrial building projects. As the business continues to expand its design-and-construct capability, the company requires an experienced Architectural Draftsperson to prepare detailed architectural documentation, support project planning and coordinate technical drawings throughout the construction process.

Our Architectural Draftsperson will be responsible for preparing architectural drawings and construction documentation, interpreting design concepts, coordinating technical information and supporting the delivery of residential and commercial construction projects. The position provides specialised drafting support across the business and contributes to efficient project delivery, design coordination and regulatory compliance.

Duties and Responsibilities

Design Documentation and Drafting
•	Prepare architectural drawings, plans, elevations, sections and detailed construction documentation using CAD, Revit and BIM software
•	Translate architectural concepts, sketches and design specifications into accurate technical drawings for construction purposes
•	Revise and update drawings to reflect design changes, engineering requirements and client variations throughout project deliver

Project Documentation and Coordination
•	Prepare documentation required for planning approvals, building permits and construction documentation packages
•	Coordinate architectural drawings with structural, civil, mechanical and other consultant documentation to minimise design conflicts
•	Maintain project drawing registers, revision histories and document control throughout each stage of construction

Technical Design Support
•	Interpret building codes, Australian Standards and planning requirements when preparing architectural documentation
•	Assist with material selections, construction detailing and specification preparation to support project outcomes
•	Produce 3D models, presentation drawings and visual representations where required to assist project coordination and client communication

Stakeholder Liaison
•	Liaise with Architects, engineers, project managers, consultants and clients to clarify design requirements and technical information
•	Coordinate drawing revisions and technical documentation arising from project meetings and consultant feedback
•	Support communication between design and construction teams to facilitate efficient project delivery

Quality Assurance and Compliance
•	Review drawings to ensure accuracy, completeness and compliance with project specifications and applicable regulations
•	Maintain drawing standards, templates and documentation procedures in accordance with company quality systems

The Structural Steel Detailer transforms architectural and engineering plans into precise 3D models and 2D shop drawings. Employer Sponsorship Available | Perth, WA | Full-Time
MYAC Resources is currently seeking experienced Sheet Metal Workers to join our growing network of leading Australian employers across Perth, Western Australia.
We have multiple long-term opportunities available for skilled tradespeople who take pride in producing high-quality workmanship and want to build a secure, rewarding career with established Australian businesses. About the Role
As a Sheet Metal Worker, you'll play a key role in the fabrication, assembly and repair of precision sheet metal components used across a variety of manufacturing, engineering and industrial projects.
Working in modern, well-equipped workshops, you'll be part of a professional team delivering quality workmanship while maintaining the highest safety standards.

Your responsibilities will include:
• Fabricating and assembling sheet metal components to specification 
• Reading and interpreting engineering drawings, technical plans and fabrication details 
• Cutting, folding, bending, rolling and shaping sheet metal 
• MIG and TIG welding where required 
• Operating fabrication equipment including press brakes, guillotines, rollers, punches and other workshop machinery 
• Measuring, marking and preparing materials for fabrication 
• Repairing, modifying and installing fabricated components 
• Conducting quality inspections to ensure finished products meet engineering specifications Maintaining workshop equipment and ensuring a clean, organised work environment 
• Working safely in accordance with all workplace health and safety procedures 

About You
To be successful in this role, you'll have:
• Trade qualification as a Sheet Metal Worker, Metal Fabricator or equivalent recognised trade qualification
• Previous experience in sheet metal fabrication 
• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and fabrication plans 
• Experience operating fabrication machinery and workshop equipment 
• Strong fabrication, measuring and welding skills 
• High attention to detail with pride in producing quality workmanship 
• Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment 
• Excellent communication and problem-solving skills 
• Strong commitment to workplace safety and quality standards 

Highly Regarded
While not essential, the following experience will be highly regarded:
• MIG and TIG welding experience 
• Stainless steel and aluminium fabrication experience 
• Experience working in manufacturing, mining or heavy industrial environments 
• Forklift Licence 
• Overhead Crane experience 
• Current Australian Driver's Licence 
• Experience with precision fabrication and custom metalwork 

Employer Sponsorship Available

MYAC Resources has extensive experience connecting skilled tradespeople with genuine long-term employment opportunities across Australia for suitably qualified candidates, employer sponsorship is available, subject to employer approval and Australian migration requirements.
Whether you're already in Australia or planning to relocate, we can help connect you with employers seeking skilled Sheet Metal Workers.

What's on Offer
• Permanent full-time position 
• Perth, Western Australia location 
• Competitive salary package with overtime opportunities 
• Long-term career stability with established Australian employers 
• Modern workshop facilities and quality equipment 
• Ongoing training and career development 
• Supportive, safety-focused team environment 
• Employer sponsorship available for eligible candidates 
• Opportunity to build a long-term career in Australia 

Why Join MYAC Resources?
MYAC Resources specialises in connecting skilled tradespeople with leading employers across Australia's manufacturing, engineering, mining and industrial sectors. We don't just recruit people—we help build long-term careers. From your initial application through to placement and ongoing support, our experienced recruitment team is committed to helping you succeed. If you're a skilled tradesperson who takes pride in quality workmanship and wants to work with reputable Australian employers, this is an opportunity you won't want to miss.

If you're an experienced Sheetmetal worker looking for your next opportunity in Perth, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your current resume and one of our recruitment specialists will be in touch
